Reverse Repo Rate is the rate at which the RBI borrows money from commercial banks

The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) enables the RBI to absorb excess liquidity from banks without requiring collateral.
It replaced the fixed-rate Reverse Repo as the floor of the Liquidity Adjustment Facility corridor in April 2022.
